As the U.S.-Iran conflict drags on, Trump in an Aug. 17 Fox News interview threatened to attack U.S. regional ally Oman if its negotiations with Iran on reopening the Strait of Hormuz were to interfere with U.S.-Iran talks on a potential peace deal. About a year and a half into his second term, President Donald Trump's approval rating among Utah voters continues to be underwater.

A new Deseret News/Hinckley Institute of Politics poll, conducted by Morning Consult, found Utahns generally aren't happy with the way Trump has handled his return to the White House. It's a trend seen in nationwide polling, too, despite the president boasting about positive ratings. [...] Jeremy Pope, a political science professor at Brigham Young University, said he thinks its true that in a lot of states Trump is underwater and his approval is "just quite bad."

"It's hard not to look ahead and wonder just how bad could it get for Republicans?" he said.
